issues.description: Replaced undefined spice blend and risotto with measured pantry spices and cooked rice; corrected the yield to two servings and set poultry endpoint at 74°C. Text review covered all four locale bodies. Recipe timing, yield, and sensory outcome remain unverified because no kitchen trial was performed; no trial evidence or restaurant provenance is claimed.
issues.suggested_fix: Have a cook prepare the recipe as written, record actual prep and cook time and yield, confirm texture and applicable safe internal temperatures, then update the article before reconsidering indexing.
